title: Camelcase Matching
summary: For an array of strings queries and a string pattern, generate a boolean array answer indicating whether each query matches the pattern by inserting lowercase English letters into the pattern.
statement: For an array of strings queries and a string pattern, generate a boolean array answer indicating whether each query matches the pattern by inserting lowercase English letters into the pattern. A match occurs if the modified pattern exactly equals the query.
constraints: Only lowercase letters may be inserted into pattern.
Return whether each query can be formed independently.
hints: Pattern characters must appear in order, and every extra query character must be lowercase.
Use a pointer into pattern for each query.
Advance on a match; reject an unmatched uppercase; accept only after consuming all pattern characters.
Those conditions are exactly insertion of lowercase characters without deleting or changing pattern.
editorial: Those conditions are exactly insertion of lowercase characters without deleting or changing pattern.

tests.explanation: FooBar, FootBall, and FrameBuffer insert only lowercase letters around F and B.
FooBar and FootBall match the longer mixed-case pattern.
